nativeDecoderComparison.scope: Unmodified native Lean library error decoders; private test-only C helper

rows.name: EAFNOSUPPORT
rows.inputMessage: Address family not supported by protocol

native.message: bad address in system call argument
native.repr: IO.Error.otherError 14 "bad address in system call argument"

rows.name: EILSEQ
rows.inputMessage: Invalid or incomplete multibyte or wide character

native.repr: IO.Error.inappropriateType none 21 "illegal operation on a directory"

rows.name: ELIBACC
rows.inputMessage: Can not access a needed shared library

rows.name: ELIBEXEC
rows.inputMessage: Cannot exec a shared library directly

rows.name: ELIBMAX
rows.inputMessage: Attempting to link in too many shared libraries

rows.name: ELOOP
rows.inputMessage: Too many levels of symbolic links

native.repr: IO.Error.invalidArgument none 40 "too many symbolic links encountered"

rows.name: ENFILE
rows.inputMessage: Too many open files in system

rows.name: ENONET
rows.inputMessage: Machine is not on the network

native.message: machine is not on the network
native.repr: IO.Error.otherError 64 "machine is not on the network"
IO.Error.resourceExhausted none 28 "no space left on device"

rows.name: ENOTNAM
rows.inputMessage: Not a XENIX named type file

native.repr: IO.Error.noSuchThing none 6 "no such device or address"

rows.name: EOVERFLOW
rows.inputMessage: Value too large for defined data type

native.message: value too large for defined data type
native.repr: IO.Error.otherError 75 "value too large for defined data type"

rows.name: ERESTART
rows.inputMessage: Interrupted system call should be restarted

rows.name: ERFKILL
rows.inputMessage: Operation not possible due to RF-kill

rows.name: ESHUTDOWN
rows.inputMessage: Cannot send after transport endpoint shutdown

native.message: cannot send after transport endpoint shutdown
native.repr: IO.Error.otherError 108 "cannot send after transport endpoint shutdown"

native.message: service not available for socket type
native.repr: IO.Error.otherError 3010 "service not available for socket type"

native.message: value too large for defined data type
native.repr: IO.Error.otherError 75 "value too large for defined data type"

harnessNotes: The first native decoder helper lacked a Repr instance and failed to compile; its output is preserved as io-decoder-baseline-r1.
The second baseline exposed a Deno decoder exception. The parallel driver now records exceptions per case so every comparison completes.
The decoder oracle calls the unmodified native Lean library through a private test-only C helper; no helper is part of the public Lean API.
All filesystem runs copy the same existing Lean fixture without changing its source. Native interpreted and C-compiled controls use independent trees.
Failures, their deployments and all release tarballs remain preserved. Only verified duplicate caches or installed copies were reclaimed.
limitations: Native-library profile verified on Linux x64; other native platforms remain unverified.
The actual-file regression covers selected error/bounds/path/order cases, not every filesystem or standard API.
POSIX unlink uses the native helper. Windows still uses the engine filesystem adapter pending its own native differential.
